events.name: Third Day with very special guest Zach Williams & Scout and the Saints
events.info: Experience THIRD DAY, the iconic band that shaped Christian music, for the final leg of their 30th Anniversary Tour. Original members Mac Powell, Mark Lee, David Carr, and Tai Anderson reunite for a limited run of U.S. shows celebrating three decades of hits from their legendary catalog. Very Special Guest Zach Williams joins each night and Scout and the Saints open, making these newly announced dates the final chapter of THIRD DAYs 30th Anniversary tour. Lineup subject to change. Discounts cannot be combined. Awakening Events/Awaking Foundation shows are required to follow local health and venue requirements. Changes in local health guidelines or venue policies are not grounds for a refund. By attending this event, you agree to all uses of photo/video content collected.
events.pleaseNote: This venue has a CLEAR BAG Policy and is CASHLESS. Please visit venue website for additional information: https://www.myfmbankarena.com/plan-your-visit

venues.name: F&M Bank Arena

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The F&M Bank Arena Box Office is open on event days only; opening two hours prior to an event start. The box office is located just outside the entrance of F&M Bank Arena at the corner of First and Main Street.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: F&M Bank Arena is a cashless venue. Credit Cards accepted: Mastercard, American Express, Visa, & Discover
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located just inside the First and Main Street Entrance at F&M Bank Arena. Tickets ordered through Ticketmaster, which are held at will call in your name, may be picked up on the day of the event by presenting your photo ID and credit card used to purchase.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking options are available downtown and within walking distance of the arena. Visit our website at myfmbankarena.com/parking for more details.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue. For more information on venue accessibility please call 931-343-FMBA (3622), email accessibilityservices@fmbankarena.com, or visit our website at myfmbankarena.com. The F&M Bank Arena Box Office is open on event days only, opening two hours prior to an event start. Box Office main phone line is open M-F during normal business hours.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on venue policies and to plan your visit please visit myfmbankarena.com
generalInfo.childRule: All children who have not reached their second birthday do not need a ticket for concerts and Austin Peay basketball games, but they must sit on the lap of the ticket holder. All children two years and older require a ticket to enter. This policy does not apply for some events. A show's individual event page will indicate the exceptions to the child ticket policy.
